observation: Fresh main preserves cycle-ledger identity and append behavior, but a mission with completed cycles could still persist closure=null or a closure.runId pointing at a different run. The current supervisor always writes closure from the same run used for the newly appended final cycle record.
changes: Require any mission with cycle > 0 to carry a closure object whose runId equals the latest durable cycle record runId.
Keep cycle-0 missions compatible with the existing null closure state.
Update the cycle-write regression and add focused durable tamper coverage for missing/mismatched closure binding.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: validMissionClosure accepted null or any syntactically-valid runId independently of the completed cycle ledger.
verification.post_fix_contract_replay: PASS: a matching latest-cycle closure is accepted; null or mismatched closure after a completed cycle fails closed.
verification.focused_regression_contract: tests/autonomous-mission-closure-cycle-binding.test.mjs covers real store writes and durable tampering; the prior cycle-write test is updated to preserve the writer's closure invariant.

truth_boundary: This cycle binds closure provenance to the latest completed cycle exactly as the current supervisor already writes it. It does not authenticate assessment contents or externally rewritten whole documents.
